subject: Prepladder Tests
title: FMGE Test Series · FMGE Test Series Year 2021 · Fmge National Mock Test #4 (Part Ii)

questions.stem: The following findings are seen in a man who presents to the OPD. The CT scan of his neck is given below. Which of the following situations is not at the risk of being converted to an open sternotomy during surgery?
questions.stemHtml: The following findings are seen in a man who presents to the OPD. The CT scan of his neck is given below. Which of the following situations is not at the risk of being converted to an open sternotomy during surgery?

options.label: B
options.text: If this is a case of revision surgery

options.label: C
options.text: Diameter of goiter is more than thoracic inlet

options.label: D
options.text: If the swelling extends into the anterior mediastinum
